data.description:
## What
Create the tests/brainstorm/ directory with the documented harness layout: README.md, fixture directory (fixtures/), golden-output assertion helpers, and a trivial test runner file (test-trivial-replay.sh).

## Why
Story f629-4fa9 DD1+DD2: The harness needs a documented layout (README.md), captured ticket-store fixture (or recorded transcript), and golden-output assertion helpers before the trivial replay can run.

## Acceptance Criteria
- tests/brainstorm/ directory created
- tests/brainstorm/README.md documents: harness design (recorded-transcript approach, not live LLM invocation), directory structure, how to add replay tests, known limitations
- tests/brainstorm/fixtures/ directory contains at least one recorded transcript fixture file (e.g., trivial-replay-fixture.txt or .json) — the trivial case: simple feature brainstorm with known structure
- tests/brainstorm/lib/assert-helpers.sh (or inline in test file) provides golden-output assertion helpers: at minimum assert_contains_marker (checks for canonical output marker like '## Context') and assert_exit_zero
- tests/brainstorm/test-trivial-replay.sh: executable bash script that runs one trivial replay against the fixture (using pre-recorded transcript, NOT live LLM), asserts exit code 0 and presence of canonical output markers
- test_harness_directory_exists test goes GREEN after this task completes

## Files to Create
- tests/brainstorm/README.md
- tests/brainstorm/fixtures/trivial-replay-fixture.txt (or similar)
- tests/brainstorm/test-trivial-replay.sh (executable)
- tests/brainstorm/lib/assert-helpers.sh (optional; may be inline in test file)

## testing_mode
GREEN
data.title: Create tests/brainstorm/ harness layout with fixture + golden-output helpers (f629-4fa9 DD1+DD2)
